Rules.InvariantScript:
Concurrent(
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locIsVisibleBoPStandardAssumptionContract: false,
            locContractTypeBoPAssumption: Blank(),
            locContractsCostsMax: 1000000000,
            locContractDevCoCostsDirty: false,
            locIsVisiblePopUpDeleteContract: false,
            locContractSpinnerInformationText: "Saving Contract data...",
            locIsContractVisiblePopUpSpinner: false,
            locIsVisibleApplyTracking: false,
            locSelectedBoPStandardContractForApply: Blank(),
            locFabricSyncCostJob: Blank()
        }
    ),
    ClearCollect(
        colApplyAndApplyAllTracking,
        'Apply and Apply All Trackings'
    ),
    ClearCollect(
        colAdminContracts,
        AddColumns(
            'BoP Contracts Standard Assumptions',
            IsFolded,
            true
        )
    ),
    ClearCollect(
        col_Costs_Flat_Cache,
        AddColumns(
            'BoP Contracts Standard Assumption DevCo Costs',
            ParentID,
            'BoP Contract Standard Assumption'.'BoP Contracts Standard Assumptions',
            CategoryName,
            'CAPEX Account'.Name,
            ParentOrder,
            RootCapexAccount.Order,
            AccountName,
            RootCapexAccount.Name
        )
    ),
    ClearCollect(
        col_Global_DevCoCosts,
        AddColumns(
            'BoP Contracts Standard Assumption DevCo Costs',
            CategoryName,
            'CAPEX Account'.Name,
            TagName,
            'CAPEX Account'.Name
        )
    )
);
ClearCollect(
    col_cmpCountryPickerItems,
    Sort(
        AddColumns(
            Countries,
            'Flag Image',
            Switch(
                Name,
                "Germany",
                'germany-flag-png-large',
                "Croatia",
                'croatia-flag-png-large',
                "France",
                'france-flag-png-large',
                "Greece",
                'greece-flag-png-large',
                "Finland",
                'finland-flag-png-large',
                "Spain",
                'spain-flag-png-large',
                "Italy",
                'italy-flag-png-large',
                "Poland",
                'poland-flag-png-large',
                "Romania",
                'romania-flag-png-large'
            ),
            Order,
            Switch(
                Name,
                "Germany",
                1,
                "Croatia",
                6,
                "France",
                2,
                "Greece",
                8,
                "Finland",
                5,
                "Spain",
                7,
                "Italy",
                4,
                "Poland",
                3,
                "Romania",
                9
            ),
            Expanded,
            false
        ),
        ThisRecord.Order
    )
);
ClearCollect(
    colCapexAllAccounts,
    Blank()
);
ClearCollect(
    colCapexAllAccountsTemporary,
    'CAPEX Account Lists'
);
ClearCollect(
    colSelectedConratctWithDevCoCosts,
    colCapexAllAccounts
);
With(
    {
        varColParentAccounts: Filter(
            colCapexAllAccountsTemporary,
            And(
                'Parent Account'.Number = "00001",
                Not(ThisRecord.Number = "10006")
            )
        )
    },
    ForAll(
        varColParentAccounts,
        With(
            {
                varId: ThisRecord.'CAPEX Account List',
                varParentId: ThisRecord.'CAPEX Account List',
                varName: ThisRecord.Name,
                varNummer: ThisRecord.Number,
                varOrder: ThisRecord.Order
            },
            With(
                {
                    varChilds: Filter(
                        colCapexAllAccountsTemporary,
                        'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List' = varId
                    )
                },
                Collect(
                    colCapexAllAccounts,
                    {
                        Id: varParentId,
                        ParentId: Blank(),
                        ParentIdLevel1: Blank(),
                        ParentIdLevel2: Blank(),
                        Nummer: varNummer,
                        Name: varName,
                        TotalCost: 0,
                        Order: varOrder,
                        Level: 1,
                        ChildsCount: CountIf(
                            varChilds,
                            true
                        ),
                        ContractDevCo: EmptyGUID,
                        Selected: false,
                        UsedInContractDevCo: EmptyGUID,
                        Used: false,
                        IsFolded: true
                    }
                );
                ForAll(
                    varChilds,
                    With(
                        {
                            varId: ThisRecord.'CAPEX Account List',
                            varParentIdLevel1: ThisRecord.'CAPEX Account List',
                            varName: ThisRecord.Name,
                            varNummer: ThisRecord.Number,
                            varOrder: ThisRecord.Order
                        },
                        With(
                            {
                                varChildsLevel2: Filter(
                                    colCapexAllAccountsTemporary,
                                    'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List' = varId
                                )
                            },
                            Collect(
                                colCapexAllAccounts,
                                {
                                    Id: varId,
                                    ParentId: varParentId,
                                    ParentIdLevel1: varParentIdLevel1,
                                    ParentIdLevel2: Blank(),
                                    Nummer: varNummer,
                                    Name: varName,
                                    TotalCost: 0,
                                    Level: 2,
                                    Order: varOrder,
                                    ChildsCount: CountIf(
                                        varChildsLevel2,
                                        true
                                    ),
                                    ContractDevCo: EmptyGUID,
                                    Selected: false,
                                    UsedInContractDevCo: EmptyGUID,
                                    Used: false,
                                    IsFolded: true
                                }
                            );
                            ForAll(
                                varChildsLevel2,
                                With(
                                    {
                                        varId: ThisRecord.'CAPEX Account List',
                                        varParentIdLevel2: ThisRecord.'CAPEX Account List',
                                        varName: ThisRecord.Name,
                                        varNummer: ThisRecord.Number,
                                        varOrder: ThisRecord.Order
                                    },
                                    With(
                                        {
                                            varChildsLevel3: Filter(
                                                colCapexAllAccountsTemporary,
                                                'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List' = varId
                                            )
                                        },
                                        Collect(
                                            colCapexAllAccounts,
                                            {
                                                Id: varId,
                                                ParentId: varParentId,
                                                ParentIdLevel1: varParentIdLevel1,
                                                ParentIdLevel2: varParentIdLevel2,
                                                Nummer: varNummer,
                                                Name: varName,
                                                TotalCost: 0,
                                                Level: 3,
                                                Order: varOrder,
                                                ChildsCount: CountIf(
                                                    varChildsLevel3,
                                                    true
                                                ),
                                                ContractDevCo: EmptyGUID,
                                                Selected: false,
                                                UsedInContractDevCo: EmptyGUID,
                                                Used: false,
                                                IsFolded: true
                                            }
                                        )
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
);
UpdateContext(
    {
        locDevContractLimitExceeded: CountIf(
            colAdminContracts,
            And(
                Country.Name = cmp_AdminContraacts_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedCountry.Name,
                Text(Technology) = cmp_AdminContraacts_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedNestedValue,
                'Contract Types' = 'BoP Contract Types'.'Development Contract'
            )
        ) >= 10,
        locConstructionContractLimitExceeded: CountIf(
            colAdminContracts,
            And(
                Country.Name = cmp_AdminContraacts_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedCountry.Name,
                Text(Technology) = cmp_AdminContraacts_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedNestedValue,
                'Contract Types' = 'BoP Contract Types'.'Construction Contract'
            )
        ) >= 10
    }
);

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txt_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_MarginFixedValue.Value)),
    gblAppResx.InputBlank,
    Not(fn_Numeric_AdminContracts.IsTwoDecimal(txt_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_MarginFixedValue.Value)),
    gblAppResx.NumericTwoDecimals,
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_MarginFixedValue.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_AdminContracts.InRange(
                txt_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_MarginFixedValue.Value,
                0,
                locContractsCostsMax
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        locContractsCostsMax,
        "###,###0,00"
    )}"
)

If(
    And(
        rad_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_Margin.Selected.Value = 'Margin (BoP Contracts Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
        rad_AddEdit_AdminContracts_RightPanel_MarginType.Selected.Value = 'Contract Margin Type'.Percentage
    ),
    80,
    0
)

And(
        rad_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_Margin.Selected.Value = 'Margin (BoP Contracts Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
        rad_AddEdit_AdminContracts_RightPanel_MarginType.Selected.Value = 'Contract Margin Type'.Percentage
    )

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    And(
        And(
            Or(
                locContractDevCoCostsDirty,
                locContractDevCoCostsCahnged
            ),
            CountIf(
                Filter(
                    col_Edit_DevCoCosts,
                    Selected = true
                ),
                true
            ) > 0
        ),
        Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_Description.Value))),
        Not(lbl_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_Description_ErrorMessage_1.Visible),
        If(
            rad_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_Margin.Selected.Value = 'Margin (BoP Contracts Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
            If(
                (rad_AddEdit_AdminContracts_RightPanel_MarginType.Selected.Value = 'Contract Margin Type'.Percentage),
                And(
                    Not(lbl_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_MarginPercentage_ErrorMessage.Visible),
                    Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_MarginPercentage.Value)))
                ),
                And(
                    Not(lbl_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_MarginFixedValue_ErrorMessage.Visible),
                    Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_MarginFixedValue.Value)))
                )
            ),
            true
        ),
        Not(IsBlank(rad_Contracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_CostsUntilClosingDate.Selected.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_MonthDifference_Month.Value)),
        Not(IsBlank(rad_Add_Edit_AdminContracts_RightPanel_NewEdit_Margin.Selected.Value))
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)
